thread:
mika: Quick FYI  after the docs migration several fragment links are misbehaving. Notably, headings inside numbered lists and table captions lost anchors. Got a user note and CI warning.
zara: Example: /guides/deploy#prereqs-for-vpc (this heading used to be under a numbered list, slugifier changed it). Also table caption 'Supported GPUs' used to be linkable but now 404s.
tom: Saw the CI linkcheck: 'Fragment not found: #supported-gpus (in /guides/deploy)'. Artifact: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4512/linkcheck.
mika: Root cause seems to be twofold: 1) our new slugifier treats list-context headings differently (prefixes with list index in some cases); 2) table captions were converted to <caption> elements with no id.
patch-bot: nightly: 3 broken fragments in build 4512. See slug dump: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4512/slugs.json
zara: Short-term plan: add explicit ids to affected headings and captions, e.g., `### Prereqs for VPC {#prereqs-for-vpc}` and `<caption id="supported-gpus">Supported GPUs</caption>` in MDX.
tom: Long-term: we should normalise the slugifier to ignore list indices and create caption ids automatically during build. Also add a compatibility mapping for external links.
mika: I'll open a small PR with explicit ids for the high-traffic pages (deploy, installer, cluster). Tom, can you prototype a caption-id plugin for the docusaurus pipeline?
tom: Yep, will sketch a plugin that injects ids for table captions and normalises list-heading slugs. Will post a draft PR.
zara: Also adding a tiny linkcheck test that asserts a handful of canonical anchors exist should catch regressions. I'll add that to `.github/workflows/linkcheck.yml`.
patch-bot: Reminder: nightly rebuild at 02:00 UTC will re-run linkcheck after PR merges.
mika: OK - action items: mika -> PR with explicit ids; tom -> caption-id plugin PR; zara -> linkcheck test. Merge order: ids first, then plugin, then tests. Ping here when ready.
